text: Appeal of Order to Comply (October 16, 2019) for 38 Barton Avenue, Unit 9.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated October 16, 2019, regarding the property located at 38 Barton Avenue, Unit 9, Folder No. 19 234566 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to January 17, 2020 for Items 1, 2 and 3.
